    """Animate a still image into a dur-seconds 1280x720 clip (zoom/pan variants)."""
    frames = int(round(dur * FPS))
    D = frames  # zoompan per-frame count
    if mode % 3 == 0:   # zoom in center
        z = f"1+0.14*on/{D-1}"
        x = "(iw-iw/zoom)/2"; y = "(ih-ih/zoom)/2"
    elif mode % 3 == 1: # zoom in toward left (action pull)
        z = f"1+0.18*on/{D-1}"
        x = "(iw-iw/zoom)/4"; y = "(ih-ih/zoom)/2"
    else:               # slow pan right
        z = "1.08"
        x = f"(iw-iw/zoom)*on/{D-1}"; y = "(ih-ih/zoom)/2"
    vf = (f"scale={W*2}:{H*2}:force_original_aspect_ratio=increase,"
          f"crop={W*2}:{H*2},"
          f"zoompan=z='{z}':x='{x}':y='{y}':d={D}:s={W}x{H}:fps={FPS},"
          f"format=yuv420p")
    run(["ffmpeg", "-y", "-loop", "1", "-i", img, "-t", f"{dur:.3f}",
         "-vf", vf, "-r", str(FPS), "-c:v", "libx264", "-preset", "fast", "-crf", "19",
         "-an", out])

def text_filter(text, fontsize, y_expr, start, end):
    alpha = f"if(lt(t,{start}+0.5),0,if(lt(t,{start}+1.0),(t-{start}-0.5)/0.5,if(gt(t,{end}-0.6),max(0,({end}-t)/0.6),1)))"
    return (f"drawtext=fontfile={FONT}:text='{text}':fontsize={fontsize}:"
            f"fontcolor=white:borderw=5:bordercolor=0xE23A3A:shadowx=3:shadowy=3:"
            f"shadowcolor=black@0.6:x=(w-text_w)/2:y={y_expr}:alpha='{alpha}'")

def build_shot(shot):
    sid = shot["id"]
    imgs = [os.path.join(ROOT, "frames", f"{n}.png") for n in shot["images"]]
    for p in imgs:
        if not os.path.isfile(p) or os.path.getsize(p) == 0:
            raise SystemExit(f"missing frame: {p}")
    aud = os.path.join(ROOT, "audio", f"n{sid:02d}.wav")
    ndur = duration_of(aud) if os.path.isfile(aud) else 0.0
    dur = max(shot["dur"], ndur + 1.2)
    # split duration across images
    n = len(imgs)
    parts = [dur / n] * n
    # round to frames, fix rounding residue on last part
    pf = [int(round(p * FPS)) for p in parts]
    pf[-1] = int(round(dur * FPS)) - sum(pf[:-1])
    subs = []
    for i, (img, f) in enumerate(zip(imgs, pf)):
        out = os.path.join(TMP, f"s{sid}_{i}.mp4")
        kenburns(img, f / FPS, out, mode=i + sid)
        subs.append(out)
    # concat subclips (same codec/size) then overlays, fades, narration
    full = os.path.join(TMP, f"s{sid}_full.mp4")
    if len(subs) == 1:
        full_in = subs[0]
    else:
        lst = os.path.join(TMP, f"s{sid}.txt")
        with open(lst, "w") as fh:
            for s in subs:
                fh.write(f"file '{s}'\n")
        run(["ffmpeg", "-y", "-f", "concat", "-safe", "0", "-i", lst, "-c", "copy", full])
        full_in = full
    filters = ["fade=t=in:st=0:d=0.3", f"fade=t=out:st={dur-0.35:.2f}:d=0.35"]
    t = shot.get("overlay", "")
    if t:
        if sid == 1:
            filters.append(text_filter(t, 96, "h*0.10", 0.2, dur))
        elif sid == 6:
            filters.append(text_filter(t, 130, "h*0.32", dur * 0.55, dur))
        elif sid == 7:
            filters.append(text_filter(t, 64, "h*0.08", 0.2, dur))
        elif sid == 8:
            filters.append(text_filter(t, 78, "h*0.76", 0.4, dur))
    out = os.path.join(ROOT, "clips", f"shot_{sid}.mp4")
    if ndur > 0:
        ac = (f"[1:a]adelay=400|400,apad[a];"
              f"[0:v]{','.join(filters)}[v];[v][a]vout")
        cmd = ["ffmpeg", "-y", "-i", full_in, "-i", aud,
               "-filter_complex", ac.replace("vout", "out"),
               "-map", "[out]", "-map", "[a]".replace("a", "v") if False else "[out]"],
        # simpler: map labels explicitly below
        cmd = ["ffmpeg", "-y", "-i", full_in, "-i", aud,
               "-filter_complex",
               f"[0:v]{','.join(filters)}[v];[1:a]adelay=400|400,apad[a]",
               "-map", "[v]", "-map", "[a]", "-t", f"{dur:.3f}",
               "-c:v", "libx264", "-preset", "fast", "-crf", "19",
               "-c:a", "aac", "-b:a", "160k", "-ar", "44100",
               "-movflags", "+faststart", out]
    else:
        cmd = ["ffmpeg", "-y", "-i", full_in,
               "-vf", ",".join(filters), "-t", f"{dur:.3f}",
               "-c:v", "libx264", "-preset", "fast", "-crf", "19",
               "-movflags", "+faststart", out]
    run(cmd)
    print(f"shot {sid}: dur={dur:.2f}s narration={ndur:.2f}s -> {out}")

def main():
    with open("/workspace/tmp/prompts.json") as f:
        shots = json.load(f)["shots"]
    only = sys.argv[1:] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else None
    for s in shots:
        if only and str(s["id"]) not in only:
            continue
        build_shot(s)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate 12 cartoon storyboard frames as SVG, render via Playwright Chromium."""
import os, random
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright

OUT = "/workspace/outputs/frames"
os.makedirs(OUT, exist_ok=True)
random.seed(7)
FONT = "'Noto Sans CJK SC', sans-serif"

RED, RED_D = "#E8433F", "#B92B28"
BLUE, BLUE_D = "#2F80ED", "#1B5FB8"
YEL, SKIN = "#FFC93C", "#FFDDB8"

def svg_open():
    return ('<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="1280" height="720" '
            'viewBox="0 0 1280 720">')

def defs():
    return f'''<defs>
<linearGradient id="sky" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
 <stop offset="0" stop-color="#8FD3FF"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#E9F8FF"/></linearGradient>
<linearGradient id="floor" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
 <stop offset="0" stop-color="#F6C876"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#E8A94F"/></linearGradient>
<radialGradient id="glow" cx="0.5" cy="0.5" r="0.5">
 <stop offset="0" stop-color="#FFF6C0" stop-opacity="1"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#FFF6C0" stop-opacity="0"/></radialGradient>
<radialGradient id="gold" cx="0.5" cy="0.5" r="0.5">
 <stop offset="0" stop-color="#FFE566" stop-opacity="0.95"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#FFC93C" stop-opacity="0"/></radialGradient>
</defs>'''

def arena_bg(halves=True):
    s = f'<rect width="1280" height="720" fill="url(#sky)"/>'
    s += '<rect x="0" y="540" width="1280" height="180" fill="url(#floor)"/>'
    if halves:
        s += '<rect x="0" y="540" width="600" height="180" fill="%s" opacity="0.12"/>' % RED
        s += '<rect x="680" y="540" width="600" height="180" fill="%s" opacity="0.12"/>' % BLUE
    s += '<line x1="640" y1="540" x2="640" y2="720" stroke="#FFF" stroke-width="6" stroke-dasharray="24 16"/>'
    s += '<line x1="0" y1="540" x2="1280" y2="540" stroke="#C98B2E" stroke-width="4"/>'
    return s

def banner():
    return ('<rect x="0" y="0" width="1280" height="90" fill="#123B66" opacity="0.92"/>'
            '<text x="640" y="60" font-size="40" fill="#FFF" text-anchor="middle" '
            f'font-family={FONT} font-weight="bold">ARCHERY TAG ARENA</text>')

def star(cx, cy, r, fill="#FFD34D", rot=0):
    import math
    pts = []
    for i in range(10):
        rr = r if i % 2 == 0 else r * 0.45
        a = math.radians(rot + i * 36 - 90)
        pts.append(f"{cx+rr*math.cos(a):.1f},{cy+rr*math.sin(a):.1f}")
    return f'<polygon points="{" ".join(pts)}" fill="{fill}"/>'

def speedlines(x, y, n=6, ln=160, color="#FFFFFF", op=0.55):
    s = f'<g stroke="{color}" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="{op}">'
    for i in range(n):
        yy = y + i * 16
        xx = x - random.randint(0, 60)
        ll = ln - random.randint(0, 70)
        s += f'<line x1="{xx}" y1="{yy}" x2="{xx+ll}" y2="{yy}"/>'
    return s + '</g>'

def arrow_h(x, y, ln=110, color="#5B4A36", tip=RED):
    return (f'<g><line x1="{x}" y1="{y}" x2="{x+ln}" y2="{y}" stroke="{color}" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round"/>'
            f'<circle cx="{x+ln+8}" cy="{y}" r="10" fill="{tip}" stroke="#FFF" stroke-width="2"/>'
            f'<path d="M {x} {y} l -18 -10 l 0 20 z" fill="{YEL}"/></g>')

def target(cx, cy, s=1.0, fallen=False):
    g = f'<g transform="translate({cx},{cy}) rotate({70 if fallen else 0}) scale({s})">'
    if not fallen:
        g += '<line x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="60" stroke="#8A5A2B" stroke-width="10"/>'
    g += ('<circle cx="0" cy="-30" r="46" fill="#FFF" stroke="#333" stroke-width="4"/>'
          '<circle cx="0" cy="-30" r="32" fill="%s"/><circle cx="0" cy="-30" r="18" fill="#FFF"/>'
          '<circle cx="0" cy="-30" r="8" fill="%s"/>' % (RED, RED)) + '</g>'
    return g

def obstacle(cx, cy, w, h, color):
    return (f'<g transform="translate({cx},{cy})">'
            f'<rect x="{-w//2}" y="{-h}" width="{w}" height="{h}" rx="26" fill="{color}" stroke="#FFF" stroke-width="5"/>'
            f'<rect x="{-w//2+14}" y="{-h+12}" width="{w-28}" height="{h-40}" rx="18" fill="#FFF" opacity="0.25"/></g>')

def char(x, y, s=1.0, color=RED, dark=RED_D, face=1, pose="stand"):
    """Side-view Q character. (x,y)=feet center."""
    flip = f'scale({face},1)' if face < 0 else ''
    rot = {"run": -10, "dodge": -28, "down": -78, "lean": 8}.get(pose, 0)
    hop = -12 if pose == "cheer" else 0
    g = f'<g transform="translate({x},{y}) rotate({rot}) {flip} scale({s}) translate(0,{hop})">'
    # legs
    if pose == "run":
        g += f'<path d="M -6 -52 L -26 -6" stroke="#3B4A5A" stroke-width="10" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none"/>'
        g += f'<path d="M 6 -52 L 30 -20" stroke="#3B4A5A" stroke-width="10" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none"/>'
        g += '<ellipse cx="-30" cy="-4" rx="12" ry="7" fill="#33404E"/><ellipse cx="34" cy="-18" rx="12" ry="7" fill="#33404E"/>'
    elif pose == "down":
        g += f'<path d="M -4 -52 L -30 -12" stroke="#3B4A5A" stroke-width="10" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none"/>'
        g += f'<path d="M 6 -52 L -14 -6" stroke="#3B4A5A" stroke-width="10" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none"/>'
    else:
        g += f'<path d="M -8 -52 L -12 -4" stroke="#3B4A5A" stroke-width="10" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none"/>'
        g += f'<path d="M 8 -52 L 14 -4" stroke="#3B4A5A" stroke-width="10" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none"/>'
        g += '<ellipse cx="-13" cy="-2" rx="12" ry="7" fill="#33404E"/><ellipse cx="15" cy="-2" rx="12" ry="7" fill="#33404E"/>'
    # shorts + jersey
    g += f'<rect x="-17" y="-62" width="34" height="18" rx="7" fill="{dark}"/>'
    g += f'<rect x="-18" y="-112" width="36" height="56" rx="12" fill="{color}"/>'
    g += f'<rect x="-18" y="-112" width="36" height="14" rx="7" fill="#FFF" opacity="0.85"/>'
    # arms
    if pose == "shoot":
        g += f'<path d="M -8 -100 L 34 -118" stroke="{SKIN}" stroke-width="9" stroke-linecap="round"/>'
        g += f'<path d="M -8 -96 L 26 -104" stroke="{SKIN}" stroke-width="9" stroke-linecap="round"/>'
    elif pose == "run":
        g += f'<path d="M -10 -100 L -34 -84" stroke="{SKIN}" stroke-width="9" stroke-linecap="round"/>'
        g += f'<path d="M 10 -100 L 34 -116" stroke="{SKIN}" stroke-width="9" stroke-linecap="round"/>'
    elif pose == "cheer":
        g += f'<path d="M -12 -104 L -30 -138" stroke="{SKIN}" stroke-width="9" stroke-linecap="round"/>'
        g += f'<path d="M 12 -104 L 30 -138" stroke="{SKIN}" stroke-width="9" stroke-linecap="round"/>'
    elif pose == "dodge":
        g += f'<path d="M -8 -100 L -34 -122" stroke="{SKIN}" stroke-width="9" stroke-linecap="round"/>'
        g += f'<path d="M 8 -96 L 26 -78" stroke="{SKIN}" stroke-width="9" stroke-linecap="round"/>'
    elif pose == "catch":
        g += f'<path d="M -10 -98 L 30 -104" stroke="{SKIN}" stroke-width="9" stroke-linecap="round"/>'
        g += f'<path d="M -6 -94 L 32 -92" stroke="{SKIN}" stroke-width="9" stroke-linecap="round"/>'
    elif pose == "down":
        g += f'<path d="M -6 -102 L -34 -120" stroke="{SKIN}" stroke-width="9" stroke-linecap="round"/>'
    else:
        g += f'<path d="M -12 -100 L -22 -70" stroke="{SKIN}" stroke-width="9" stroke-linecap="round"/>'
        g += f'<path d="M 12 -100 L 24 -72" stroke="{SKIN}" stroke-width="9" stroke-linecap="round"/>'
    # head + hair + mask
    g += f'<circle cx="0" cy="-136" r="22" fill="{SKIN}"/>'
    g += f'<path d="M -22 -140 a 22 22 0 0 1 44 0 z" fill="#4A3728"/>'
    g += f'<rect x="-22" y="-144" width="44" height="15" rx="7" fill="#26313D" opacity="0.95"/>'
    g += f'<line x1="-22" y1="-137" x2="-30" y2="-136" stroke="{color}" stroke-width="4"/>'
    g += '<circle cx="-8" cy="-136" r="4" fill="#FFF"/><circle cx="8" cy="-136" r="4" fill="#FFF"/>'
    g += '<circle cx="-7" cy="-136" r="2" fill="#222"/><circle cx="9" cy="-136" r="2" fill="#222"/>'
    g += '<path d="M -6 -122 q 6 5 12 0" stroke="#B05A3A" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>'
    # bow for shoot/stand
    if pose in ("shoot", "stand"):
        g += (f'<path d="M 36 -142 Q 62 -120 36 -98" stroke="#7A4B1E" stroke-width="6" fill="none"/>'
              f'<line x1="36" y1="-142" x2="36" y2="-98" stroke="#EEE" stroke-width="2"/>'
              f'<line x1="30" y1="-120" x2="58" y2="-120" stroke="#5B4A36" stroke-width="5"/>'
              f'<circle cx="62" cy="-120" r="6" fill="{YEL}"/>')
    if pose == "catch":
        g += arrow_h(24, -98, 20, tip=YEL)
    return g + '</g>'

def team(x0, y0, n, color, dark, face, s=0.9):
    out = ""
    for i in range(n):
        out += char(x0 + i * 70, y0 - (10 if i % 2 else 0), s=s, color=color, dark=dark, face=face,
                    pose="stand" if i % 2 == 0 else "cheer")
    return out

# ---------------- scenes ----------------

def s01a():
    s = svg_open() + defs() + arena_bg() + banner()
    s += obstacle(330, 560, 130, 110, RED); s += obstacle(950, 560, 130, 110, BLUE)
    s += obstacle(500, 560, 90, 70, YEL); s += obstacle(780, 560, 90, 70, YEL)
    s += target(120, 600, 0.8); s += target(1160, 600, 0.8)
    for i in range(5):
        s += char(180 + i * 70, 640 - (8 if i % 2 else 0), 0.95, RED, RED_D, 1, "shoot" if i == 2 else "stand")
        s += char(880 + i * 70, 640 - (8 if i % 2 else 0), 0.95, BLUE, BLUE_D, -1, "stand" if i != 2 else "cheer")
    s += '<rect x="560" y="430" width="160" height="110" rx="14" fill="#FFF" opacity="0.9"/>'
    s += f'<text x="640" y="478" font-size="30" text-anchor="middle" font-family={FONT} fill="#123B66" font-weight="bold">安全区</text>'
    s += f'<text x="640" y="516" font-size="20" text-anchor="middle" font-family={FONT} fill="#5B6B7B">中立 · 禁射</text>'
    s += arrow_h(760, 350, 160, tip=YEL) + speedlines(700, 336, 5, 200, op=0.5)
    return s + '</svg>'

def s01b():
    s = svg_open() + defs()
    s += '<rect width="1280" height="720" fill="#123B66"/>'
    s += '<circle cx="520" cy="360" r="420" fill="url(#glow)"/>'
    # big bow
    s += '<g transform="translate(420,360) rotate(-18)">'
    s += '<path d="M 0 -260 Q 190 0 0 260" stroke="#8A5A2B" stroke-width="26" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>'
    s += '<path d="M 0 -260 Q 190 0 0 260" stroke="#A9702F" stroke-width="12" fill="none"/>'
    s += '<line x1="0" y1="-260" x2="0" y2="260" stroke="#F2F2F2" stroke-width="5"/>'
    s += '<line x1="-40" y1="0" x2="330" y2="0" stroke="#5B4A36" stroke-width="14" stroke-linecap="round"/>'
    s += '<circle cx="345" cy="0" r="26" fill="%s" stroke="#FFF" stroke-width="5"/>' % YEL
    s += '<path d="M -40 0 l -50 -22 l 0 44 z" fill="%s"/>' % RED
    s += '</g>'
    s += speedlines(820, 240, 10, 420, color="#FFD34D", op=0.8)
    s += speedlines(800, 420, 8, 380, color="#FFF", op=0.5)
    s += f'<text x="980" y="600" font-size="44" fill="#FFF" font-family={FONT} font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle"> foam tip · 安全箭头</text>'.replace(" foam tip · ", "安全泡沫箭头 · ")
    return s + '</svg>'

def s02a():
    s = svg_open() + defs()
    s += '<rect width="1280" height="720" fill="#2E7D4F"/>'
    s += '<rect x="60" y="40" width="1160" height="640" rx="24" fill="url(#floor)"/>'
    s += '<rect x="60" y="40" width="520" height="640" rx="24" fill="%s" opacity="0.18"/>' % RED
    s += '<rect x="700" y="40" width="520" height="640" rx="24" fill="%s" opacity="0.18"/>' % BLUE
    s += '<rect x="580" y="40" width="120" height="640" fill="%s" opacity="0.75"/>' % YEL
    s += '<rect x="60" y="40" width="1160" height="640" rx="24" fill="none" stroke="#FFF" stroke-width="8"/>'
    # labels
    s += f'<text x="320" y="110" font-size="40" text-anchor="middle" font-family={FONT} fill="{RED_D}" font-weight="bold">红队区域</text>'
    s += f'<text x="960" y="110" font-size="40" text-anchor="middle" font-family={FONT} fill="{BLUE_D}" font-weight="bold">蓝队区域</text>'
    s += f'<text x="640" y="90" font-size="26" text-anchor="middle" font-family={FONT} fill="#7A5A00" font-weight="bold">安全中立区</text>'
    # obstacles + targets
    s += obstacle(240, 400, 110, 150, RED); s += obstacle(400, 560, 90, 110, YEL); s += obstacle(240, 620, 130, 100, RED)
    s += obstacle(1040, 400, 110, 150, BLUE); s += obstacle(880, 560, 90, 110, YEL); s += obstacle(1040, 620, 130, 100, BLUE)
    s += target(120, 660, 0.55); s += target(120, 520, 0.55)
    s += target(1160, 660, 0.55); s += target(1160, 520, 0.55)
    # mini players as dots with bows
    for i in range(5):
        yy = 260 + i * 60
        s += f'<circle cx="330" cy="{yy}" r="16" fill="{RED}" stroke="#FFF" stroke-width="3"/>'
        s += f'<line x1="346" y1="{yy}" x2="378" y2="{yy}" stroke="#5B4A36" stroke-width="4"/>'
        s += f'<circle cx="950" cy="{yy}" r="16" fill="{BLUE}" stroke="#FFF" stroke-width="3"/>'
        s += f'<line x1="934" y1="{yy}" x2="902" y2="{yy}" stroke="#5B4A36" stroke-width="4"/>'
    s += f'<text x="640" y="700" font-size="22" text-anchor="middle" font-family={FONT} fill="#FFF" opacity="0.9">俯视场地示意图 · 半场篮球场大小 · 中间禁射</text>'
    return s + '</svg>'

def s03a():
    s = svg_open() + defs() + arena_bg() + banner()
    s += '<rect x="540" y="470" width="200" height="70" rx="10" fill="#FFF" opacity="0.9"/>'
    s += f'<text x="640" y="515" font-size="26" text-anchor="middle" font-family={FONT} fill="#123B66" font-weight="bold">抢箭！</text>'
    for i in range(5):
        s += arrow_h(560 + i * 18, 560, 30, tip=YEL)
    for i in range(3):
        s += char(140 + i * 90, 640 - i * 14, 1.0, RED, RED_D, 1, "run")
        s += char(1140 - i * 90, 640 - i * 14, 1.0, BLUE, BLUE_D, -1, "run")
    s += speedlines(60, 560, 6, 150, op=0.5) + speedlines(1150, 560, 6, 150, op=0.5)
    for i in range(8):
        s += f'<circle cx="{random.randint(120,420)}" cy="{random.randint(600,690)}" r="{random.randint(8,18)}" fill="#E8CBA0" opacity="0.7"/>'
        s += f'<circle cx="{random.randint(860,1160)}" cy="{random.randint(600,690)}" r="{random.randint(8,18)}" fill="#E8CBA0" opacity="0.7"/>'
    return s + '</svg>'

def s04a():
    s = svg_open() + defs() + arena_bg() + banner()
    s += obstacle(360, 640, 150, 190, RED)
    s += char(400, 660, 1.05, RED, RED_D, 1, "shoot")
    s += arrow_h(470, 520, 200, tip=YEL) + speedlines(430, 506, 5, 200, op=0.6)
    s += char(860, 620, 1.05, BLUE, BLUE_D, 1, "dodge")
    s += speedlines(950, 560, 6, 170, op=0.55)
    s += obstacle(1080, 640, 130, 160, BLUE)
    s += '<rect x="640" y="140" width="300" height="64" rx="12" fill="#123B66" opacity="0.92"/>'
    s += f'<text x="790" y="184" font-size="32" text-anchor="middle" font-family={FONT} fill="#FFF" font-weight="bold">掩体走位 · 移动射击</text>'
    return s + '</svg>'

def s04b():
    s = svg_open() + defs() + arena_bg() + banner()
    s += '<circle cx="760" cy="400" r="300" fill="url(#gold)"/>'
    for i in range(12):
        import math
        a = i * 30 * math.pi / 180
        s += f'<line x1="760+{40*math.cos(a):.0f}" y1="400+{40*math.sin(a):.0f}" x2="760+{110*math.cos(a):.0f}" y2="400+{110*math.sin(a):.0f}" stroke="#FFD34D" stroke-width="10" stroke-linecap="round"/>'

    s += '<rect x="540" y="140" width="260" height="60" rx="12" fill="#123B66" opacity="0.92"/>'

def s05a():
    s = svg_open() + defs() + arena_bg() + banner()
    for i, xx in enumerate((380, 640, 900)):
        s += target(xx, 560, 1.0, fallen=(i == 1))
    s += arrow_h(560, 330, 90, tip=YEL); s += arrow_h(700, 300, 60, tip=YEL); s += arrow_h(620, 380, 40, tip=YEL)

    return s + '</svg>'

def s06a():
    s = svg_open() + defs()
    s += '<rect width="1280" height="720" fill="#0E2A4A"/>'
    s += '<rect x="0" y="560" width="1280" height="160" fill="#1E4A78"/>'
    s += '<circle cx="640" cy="330" r="380" fill="url(#glow)" opacity="0.7"/>'
    for i in range(9):
        s += f'<polygon points="640,60 {620+i*5},330 {660-i*5},330" fill="#FFF" opacity="0.06"/>'
    s += char(300, 640, 1.3, RED, RED_D, 1, "shoot")

    s += speedlines(430, 415, 5, 220, color="#FFD34D", op=0.8)
    s += speedlines(660, 415, 5, 220, color="#9AD1FF", op=0.8)
    s += f'<text x="640" y="140" font-size="52" text-anchor="middle" font-family={FONT} fill="#FFF" font-weight="bold" opacity="0.95">一箭定胜负</text>'
    return s + '</svg>'

def s06b():
    s = svg_open() + defs() + arena_bg() + banner()
    s += target(980, 600, 1.2, fallen=False)
    s += '<path d="M 935 555 L 1025 645 M 1025 555 L 935 645" stroke="#7A4B1E" stroke-width="8"/>'
    s += star(980, 500, 55) + star(880, 420, 34, fill="#FF9F43") + star(1080, 430, 30)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Concat 8 shot clips, add synthesized percussive BGM, output final promo video."""
import json, subprocess, os

ROOT = "/workspace/outputs"
clips = [f"{ROOT}/clips/shot_{i}.mp4" for i in range(1, 9)]

def run(cmd):
    r = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True)
    if r.returncode != 0:
        print(r.stderr[-2500:])
        raise SystemExit("ffmpeg failed")

def dur(p):
    r = subprocess.run(["ffprobe", "-v", "error", "-show_entries", "format=duration",
                        "-of", "default=nw=1:nk=1", p], capture_output=True, text=True)
    return float(r.stdout.strip())

total = sum(dur(c) for c in clips)
print(f"total video: {total:.2f}s")

# 1) concat via filter (re-encode, uniform)
inputs = []
for c in clips:
    inputs += ["-i", c]
n = len(clips)
fc = "".join(f"[{i}:v][{i}:a]" for i in range(n)) + f"concat=n={n}:v=1:a=1[v][a]"
run(["ffmpeg", "-y", *inputs, "-filter_complex", fc, "-map", "[v]", "-map", "[a]",
     "-c:v", "libx264", "-preset", "fast", "-crf", "19",
     "-c:a", "pcm_s16le", "-ar", "44100", f"{ROOT}/tmp_concat.mp4"])

# 2) synthesized BGM: 140bpm kick + offbeat hats + backbeat snare (looped via aevalsrc)
bpm = 140.0
beat = 60.0 / bpm           # 0.42857
bar = beat * 4
kick  = f"0.85*sin(2*PI*55*t)*exp(-20*mod(t\,{beat:.5f}))"
hat   = f"0.13*(random(0)*2-1)*exp(-70*mod(t+{beat/2:.5f}\,{beat:.5f}))"
sn1   = f"0.22*(random(1)*2-1)*exp(-24*abs(mod(t\,{bar:.5f})-{bar/4:.5f}))*between(mod(t\,{bar:.5f})\,{bar*0.25-0.07:.5f}\,{bar*0.25+0.07:.5f})"
sn2   = f"0.22*(random(2)*2-1)*exp(-24*abs(mod(t+{bar/2:.5f}\,{bar:.5f})-{bar/4:.5f}))*between(mod(t+{bar/2:.5f}\,{bar:.5f})\,{bar*0.25-0.07:.5f}\,{bar*0.25+0.07:.5f})"
expr = f"{kick}+{hat}+{sn1}+{sn2}"
run(["ffmpeg", "-y", "-f", "lavfi",
     "-i", f"aevalsrc={expr}:s=44100:d={total:.3f}",
     "-af", "lowpass=f=3800,dynaudnorm=f=150:g=15", "-c:a", "pcm_s16le",
     f"{ROOT}/bgm.wav"])

# 3) mix BGM under narration (BGM ~ -20dB)
run(["ffmpeg", "-y", "-i", f"{ROOT}/tmp_concat.mp4", "-i", f"{ROOT}/bgm.wav",
     "-filter_complex",
     "[1:a]volume=0.16[b];[0:a][b]amix=inputs=2:duration=first:dropout_transition=0,"
     "alimiter=limit=0.95[a]",
     "-map", "0:v", "-map", "[a]",
     "-c:v", "copy", "-c:a", "aac", "-b:a", "160k",
     "-movflags", "+faststart", f"{ROOT}/攻防箭宣传片_final.mp4"])

os.remove(f"{ROOT}/tmp_concat.mp4")
os.remove(f"{ROOT}/bgm.wav")
out = f"{ROOT}/攻防箭宣传片_final.mp4"
print("final:", out, f"{os.path.getsize(out)/1e6:.1f} MB, {dur(out):.2f}s")
